title: implement-sensitivity-tiering-rbacv2-audit-retention-gateway
author: Evan Cho
description: Motivation: implement tenant sensitivity tiers so audit retention and KMS usage policies map to data sensitivity levels instead of a single residency knob. This PR adds an RBAC v2 policy adapter that understands sensitivity_tier metadata on service and dataset resources and a small audit-retention gateway that applies retention windows and KMS scoping per-tier. Design summary: 1) RBAC: introduce sensitivity predicates in the decision engine and a new SensitivityTier resource type. 2) Audit: retention gateway sits between write requests and the audit store; it annotates events with tiered retention and triggers long-term storage hooks for P0/P1 tiers. 3) KMS: KMS key selection now includes optional tier hints to prefer stronger-key wrap for higher tiers. 4) Migration: a migration that backfills default "tier=standard" for existing tenants and a small operator command to reclassify datasets. Checklist: - [x] Add RBAC policy predicates and unit tests - [x] Implement audit gateway and retention metadata propagation - [x] Add KMS-tier selection hooks and integration tests - [x] SQL migration and operator helper - [x] Docs and runbook updates - [x] E2E regression test in perf-canary Summary of changes, in one line: add sensitivity-tier-aware RBAC predicates, audit-retention gateway, KMS tier hinting, migration and docs.

release_notes: Add sensitivity-tiering to RBAC v2 and audit pipeline: operators can classify datasets into sensitivity tiers (standard, restricted, critical). Audit retention and KMS selection are now tier-aware; a migration backfills default 'standard' for existing tenants. Feature is behind feature flag 'sensitivity_tiering' and gated for enterprise tenants.
notes_for_ops: Operator commands: 'redwood-ctl reclassify-dataset --dataset-id <id> --tier restricted' to move a dataset; verify via 'SELECT dataset_id, sensitivity_tier FROM catalog.datasets WHERE dataset_id=...'. If audit-gateway queue depth > 500, toggle feature flag to 'off' and monitor retention_fallback_count metric.
testing_notes: Local test harness: makefile target 'make test-e2e-audit-gateway' runs the gateway with kms-stub and a sqlite audit store. Perf-canary config added under perf-canary/fixtures/sensitivity-tiering to validate baseline latency impact (expected +3-8ms p50).
